text:
Sana: Quick design question: table rows in the new dashboard are getting crowded when we add the action buttons (Edit, More, Retry). At 320px width the hit targets are tiny and the spacing looks off. Figma: https://figma.com/file/newgrid
Omar: Are we using the compact spacing token set? If so those tokens reduce padding on cells which shrinks hit areas. For touch we should prefer at least 44px tappable areas per WCAG mobile guidance.
Priya: UX tradeoff: we want density for power users but need tappable targets on mobile. Suggest we collapse secondary actions into a kebab menu at small breakpoints and keep primary action as a visible icon button.
Liam: Also noticed tooltip placement overlaps toasts in the top-right when you hover a row action while a transient toast is visible. Tooltips get cut off. Maybe tooltips should render in a portal above toasts or we surface tooltips below the element when toasts present.
Sana: Good catch. That was causing a few user test fails yesterday. We don't want tooltips hidden by toasts. Portal ordering could fix it but we need z-index rules in the tokens.
Omar: Proposal: add a new layering token: token.layer.tooltip = 9000, toast = 8500, modal = 10000. Update docs so implementers know ordering. Also revisit spacing token names: spacing.compact-xxs is confusing. Rename to spacing.density.compact-2 etc.
Priya: For accessibility: make sure icon buttons include accessible names (aria-label) and visible focus rings aren't clipped when we reduce padding. Also don't rely solely on title attribute for tooltip content; use aria-describedby when helpful.
Liam: On mobile we should make the row actions expand into a bottom sheet rather than a popover, that preserves touch targets. We'll need a bottom-sheet component variant in the library.
Sana: Copy nit: change "More" to "More actions" for screen readers so the context is clear when reading within a table row.
Omar: I'll draft a spec: 1) kebab menu on <480px, 2) primary icon persists, 3) add layering tokens, 4) rename compact spacing tokens, 5) tooltip portal above toasts. ETA tomorrow.
Priya: A11y-bot note: run the row-action keyboard flow through NVDA/VoiceOver. I can schedule a quick pass. Also check focus order for the bottom sheet variant.
a11y-bot: created checklist ticket #A11-472 in design-ux with steps: keyboard nav, aria-label presence, tooltip descr, mobile bottom-sheet focus trapping.
Sana: I'll update the Figma and add an example of the bottom-sheet and the kebab menu. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
